title: Check HubSpot deal activity links with AI before a call
h1: see which activities are linked to a hubspot deal
description: Ask an AI bot to list activity links on a HubSpot deal. See the first-page limit and why linked calls and emails are not the same as their full contents.
keyword: list hubspot deal activities with ai
keywords: hubspot deal linked calls and notes
answer: before a deal call, a bot can check which notes, calls, emails, meetings and tasks are linked to the hubspot deal you name. it finds the deal with search deals, then lists the returned activity links in your chat. the important limit is coverage: this action returns only the first group of links, not a complete history or the full words of each activity.
og_line: activity links, with their limits visible.
what:
this is a way to inspect the activities attached to a deal rather than read every conversation. the bot finds your named deal, checks the match and asks for its activity links. the returned entries tell it which activity records are associated with that deal.

the default request asks for up to 25 entries. a larger requested limit does not make the result a complete history: only the first group is returned, and the count describes those retrieved links. reading an email, call note or meeting content needs a separate action for that activity.
uses: check whether the deal you are discussing has any returned call or meeting links
make a starting list of activity records to open before a customer conversation
spot that an expected note is absent from the returned group and flag it for a person to check
separate linked tasks from linked emails when deciding what evidence to read next

routine.message: every wednesday at 9, find the open renewal deals for northwren supply in hubspot and show me the deal matches if there is more than one. list the activity links returned for each confirmed deal, grouped into notes, calls, emails, meetings and tasks, and put the result here. say plainly that the list covers only the first returned group and does not include activity contents. never treat an absent link as proof nobody contacted the customer, and never edit the deal.
routine.needs: hubspot connected, with read only access for this bot
routine.output:
northwren supply renewal

returned activity links: 2 notes, 1 call, 3 emails, 1 task.
no meeting link in this returned group.

this is not the full activity history, and the linked records have not been opened.

steps: add hubspot in **Connected apps** and keep the deal-review bot on **read only**.
name the deal with its customer and purpose, then check the search match before asking for activity links.
ask the bot to label its count as returned links and avoid summarising content it has not read.
review the first Wednesday result; **Edit** on the routine card lets you narrow which deals it checks next time.
watch: only the first group of activity associations is retrieved. the returned count must not be presented as the total number of deal activities.
a linked email or call is a record to investigate, not the contents of that conversation.
missing links in this response do not prove that a meeting or customer contact never happened.

faq.q: can it tell me what the last sales call said?
faq.a: not from this action alone. it lists linked activity records; the bot needs a separate read of the relevant call record before summarising its contents.

faq.q: does increasing the limit give the entire deal history?
faq.a: no. the action still returns its first group of associations. ask the bot to state exactly what it retrieved and keep any completeness claim out of the summary.

faq.q: does this change the deal's activities?
faq.a: no. this action only lists the existing links, and a bot with read only access cannot use the deal-changing actions.
